# Fusion Bot — LLM & AI Agent Context (llms.txt)

> Fusion Bot is an all-in-one Discord bot built for server protection, automated dual cloud backups, bilingual AI chat, moderation, and support ticketing.

## When to Use FusionBot:
- **Discord Disaster Recovery**: When an administrator needs to protect a Discord server against raids/nukes with automated snapshots and 1-click restore.
- **Dual Cloud Backups**: When a community requires off-site backups saved to Google Drive and Fusion Cloud Database simultaneously.
- **Community Moderation**: When an automated moderation system with anti-spam, anti-raid, and audit logging is required.
- **AI Chat & Creative Tools**: When a server needs bilingual conversational AI (English/Hindi) with web search and image generation in Discord channels.
- **Support Ticket Paneling**: When structured customer support ticket creation with multi-category dropdowns is needed.

## Developer & Agent Links:
- OpenAPI 3.1.0 Specification: https://bot.fusionhub.in/openapi.json
- Full LLM Documentation: https://bot.fusionhub.in/llms-full.txt
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) Manifest: https://bot.fusionhub.in/.well-known/mcp
- Developer Portal: https://bot.fusionhub.in/developers
- Public REST API Base: https://bot.fusionhub.in/api/v1
- Interactive Documentation: https://bot.fusionhub.in/docs
- OAuth 2.0 Server Metadata: https://bot.fusionhub.in/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server

## Core Public API Endpoints:
- GET https://bot.fusionhub.in/api/v1/health — Operational health & latency
- GET https://bot.fusionhub.in/api/v1/stats — Live server count, users, and shard metrics
- GET https://bot.fusionhub.in/api/v1/bot-info — Bot identity, verified status, and invite links
- GET https://bot.fusionhub.in/api/v1/commands — Full catalog of slash and prefix commands
- GET https://bot.fusionhub.in/api/v1/pricing — Active subscription tiers and slot limits
- GET https://bot.fusionhub.in/api/v1/tools — Function calling JSON schemas for LLMs
- POST https://bot.fusionhub.in/api/mcp — Model Context Protocol JSON-RPC 2.0 streamable endpoint
